description: This file defines the interface and class structure for the OCDM plugin, including class declarations, nested classes, and method signatures related to content decryption management within the WPEFramework plugin architecture.

classes.name: OCDM
classes.description: Main plugin class implementing IPlugin, IWeb, and JSONRPC interfaces, managing content decryption and plugin lifecycle.

classes.name: Data
classes.description: JSON container class for plugin data, including a list of systems.

classes.name: System
classes.description: Represents a content decryption system with a name and designators.

classes.name: Notification
classes.description: Inner class handling remote connection notifications for the OCDM plugin.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the plugin with service configuration.

methods.name: Deinitialize
methods.description: Deinitializes the plugin, cleaning up resources.

methods.name: Process
methods.description: Processes web requests and generates responses.
